title: "Athletes Data Pairwise Comparison Survey (Cycle Tracking) - Privacy/Sharing Question" author: "Brad Stenger" date: "2026-07-28" ---


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

json <- '{
    "reporting": ["sent automatically by an app or device","reported directly by the athlete"],
    "privacy": ["statistical noise","anonymization","athlete consent"],
    "sharing": ["coaches","whole team","research","public"],
    "payment": ["none","small","large"]
}'

abc <- jsonlite::fromJSON(json)
combinations <- tidyr::expand_grid(abc$reporting,abc$privacy,abc$sharing)
names(combinations) <- c("reporting","privacy","sharing")

# Cycle tracking data is [reporting] and privacy assured by [privacy] when that data is shared with [recipient].
combinations$qualtrics <- paste0("Your cycle-tracking data is ", combinations$reporting," with privacy assurance based on ", combinations$privacy," and then shared with ", combinations$sharing,".") 
combinations$qualtrics
```
